title: Cozy Seacrest Beach Vacation Home with Hot Tub, Porch & Bikes
meta_description: Camp Seabreeze offers a 3BR/2BA retreat for 8 guests with a hot tub, wrap-around porch, and bikes—just 300 yards from the beach and near Rosemary & Alys Beach.
description_expanded: AboutNew Rental! Golf Cart | Hot Tub | Camp Seabreeze – Your Luxury 30A Beach Retreat Seacrest Beach | 3 Bedrooms | Sleeps 8 | Prime Location | Hot Tub Why Guests Love Camp Seabreeze and Location Perks: • Close to the Beach – Just 300 yards to the sugar-white sands of Seacrest Beach • 6 Person Hot Tub • Prime 30A Location – A perfect retreat, tucked away yet close to all the action • Golf Cart - Add a Street Legal Golf Cart and Receive a 50% Discount off the Golf Cart Rental Rate • Bikes! • Luxury and Modern Décor – Open concept living area • Multiple Outdoor Spaces – Screened-in porch, pergola, fire pit, and picnic area for ultimate relaxation • Outdoor grill • Beach Essentials – 4 beach chairs and a beach umbrella • Spacious Wrap-Around Porch – Enjoy morning coffee in a peaceful setting • Family games and puzzles! • Shopping, Dining and Entertainment – Close to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and The Big Chill for dining, shopping, and entertainment • Professionally Managed – 24/7 service for a seamless stay • Starter Amenities – Bathrooms and kitchen stocked with essentials, including Starbucks coffee and bottled water Your Luxury Vacation Rental Awaits Located in the charming Seabreeze East neighborhood, Camp Seabreeze is the perfect blend of coastal comfort and modern luxury. Just steps from the pristine beaches of 30A, this stunning 30A vacation home offers everything you need for an unforgettable getaway. Please note: The indoor fireplace is decorative only and intended for visual enjoyment. Inside, an open-concept living and dining area features abundant natural light, a bright white kitchen, and stylish furnishings. The wrap-around front porch invites you to relax with your morning coffee, while the spacious backyard with a fire pit is ideal for evening gatherings under the stars. This 30A vacation rental comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests with thoughtfully designed bedrooms: • Master Bedroom: King bed • Guest Bedroom: Queen bed • Bunk Room: Two sets of twin bunks (sleeps 4) Beyond the home, explore nearby hotspots like The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and the famous 30A bike trail. Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, Camp Seabreeze is your ultimate vacation retreat. Secure Your Stay – Limited Availability! Book now to experience the best of luxury, location, and laid-back beach living on 30A!
